method: Decimal precision100 from CSV strings; required P1-P4; missing P5=0; observed components [0,1]; population>0; inclusive S [.90,1.10]; y=int(5*sum(P3:P5)>S). O=T-H; train label months inclusive O-35..O. Restricted uses target-valid areas. Summary medians/minima across months with at least one valid target label (not necessarily class-positive) only. Capacity=sum(min(ceil(.2*n),n-1)) for areas n>=2, singleton zero; not stratified split. Stage3 requires origin >= January freeze+1.
limitations: Counts precede feature, geometry, unseen-area and model-fit eligibility checks.
Validation capacity uses existing unstratified within-area20percent rule; it does not assert positive validation support or successful splits.
Stage1 candidate and Stage3 remaining counts are label coverage, not successful partitions or final paired scores.
Restricted fold counts emulate filtering historical training areas by valid target-month area membership.
No predictive performance or nonzero consensus weights have been computed.
Period extension and removal of target-month-area training filtering are proposals pending user decisions.
